text.text_excerpt: I've heard nothing but great things about Willie Maes, but I'm never in the 7th ward and fried chicken is just an occasional thing for me. I was craving it today and decided to head over to this much more conveniently located offshoot of the original. The place is set up to where you order at the counter and they bring it out to you. The cashier and food runners were super friendly. I ordered the fried chicken dinner with macaroni and cheese with peas with white meat. My friend Greg H. ordered chicken tenders with sweet potato fries, and then we ordered 4 cornbread muffins on the side. Our food came out in about 10 minutes. My chicken came was hot, both in temperature in flavor. The chick...

I stopped here later at night when a friend and I forgot to eat dinner. The waitstaff/cashier who dealt with us was really great, and our food came out surprisingly fast. On top of that it seemed like they made the food to order for us and it wasn't sitting there all day. For fried chicken it's pricey, but Willie Mae's has a name people know and is considered some of the best fried chicken in the U.S. (??? surprising). The fried chicken is definitely the deepest fried I have ever had, but that's definitely a good thing. We went with the dark meat option and completely destroyed our chicken basket, it was super tasty. We also got a side of red beans and rice (my favorite) that was perfectl...

I just LOVE people who knock off a few stars for a long wait at a place that just opened. Good Lord. Pro tip: if a place is new, expect a bit of a wait. Like Katie A., I have never been to the original Willie Mae's. I just never find myself in the 5th ward when I am craving fried chicken. When I heard that there was going to be an Uptown location, I though to myself, "Hey, you're Uptown all the time! Now you can go get chicken there!" and today I did just that. I stopped in at about 2:30, and although the large lunch crowd had moved on, there was still a nice gang of people in there. I was still able to walk up to the counter and order pretty quickly.
